name: FireFly Metals Ltd
summary: FireFly Metals Ltd, a West Perth company dating from 2004, explores for mineral deposits in Canada and Australia, mainly gold and copper. It holds an interest in a copper-gold project at Green Bay in Newfoundland, 70% of the Pickle Crow gold project in Ontario, and 90% of the Limestone Well vanadium-titanium project in Western Australia. It was formerly Auteco Minerals Limited.
